# One wire settling two invoices and leaving a residue.
#
# `Assets:Bank:USD +330.00` against four receivable splits: −60.00 and −40.00
# which together settle one invoice, −180.00 which settles another, and −50.00
# left over as the customer's credit.
#
# The Q-016 shape — one deposit covering several records — with a two-tranche
# settlement and a residue on top. It is what tells the writer's idea of a
# residue from the reader's: the writer skips a split sitting in another
# invoice's lot, because that is that record's portion and was never left
# over.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction with five splits, four on the
# receivable and none in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.

	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -60.00 USD
